title: POLY PMNA Android app 3.9
message: Install this signed release update to replace older builds and keep receiving future app updates from the homepage.
releaseNotes: Signed public release APK for Android installs and upgrades.
New lesson push notifications through Firebase Cloud Messaging.
Fixes the Recent Apps lifecycle so minimized POLY PMNA remains available in Android's app switcher.
Includes the improved Ask POLY mobile chat experience.
